paper_title: Characterization of Permutation Gates in the Third Level of the Clifford Hierarchy
classifications: Theory of computation → Quantum information theory
statement: ▶ Conjecture 12. Every element of the Clifford hierarchy is generalized semi-Clifford.
context: The conjecture that every gate in CH is generalized semi-Clifford [36] remains open. Partial progress was made in [1]. ▶ Conjecture 12. Every element of the Clifford hierarchy is generalized semi-Clifford. ▶ Remark 13. A generalized semi-Clifford gate takes the form ϕ1 πdϕ2 . A similar form of πdϕ is considered in the context of approximate unitary designs or pseudorandom unitaries in [29, 11], where ϕ and π are sampled uniformly at random from their respective groups, and d is a diagonal gate with random ±1 entries. 2.2 Polynomial representations of permutations To study the permutation gates in the Clifford hierarchy, we represent them as collections of Boolean polynomials.
